name: Jusant
short_description: Climb a vast tower of rock that rises out of a dried-up sea, hand over hand, with a rope and a little water creature.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Climb a vast tower of rock that rises out of a dried-up sea, hand over hand, with a rope and a little water creature.

identity.core_loop: Look up, plan a route, reach with the left hand then the right, place a piton, swing, rest on a ledge, read what the old climbers left behind.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Physical and patient; each hold is a choice of hand, and the rope makes falling safe.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Almost no HUD: stamina shows in the climber's breathing and trembling arms. Handholds read by their shape and colour on the rock. Story lives in letters and abandoned homes.

identity.art_direction: Big sculpted rock in soft gradients, sun-bleached colour and deep atmospheric haze, clean shapes without outlines.

rendering.signature: Huge sculpted rock in soft sun-bleached gradients with deep height haze, clean comic-like shapes and no outlines.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Height haze sells scale for climbing: the further down, the paler and bluer the world.

identity.audio_mood: Sparse soundscape, wind and stone; music swells as you reach new heights.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Show stamina on the body, not a bar; make the safety rope the fun of falling. Handholds that read by shape are a no-HUD climbing grammar.
